en.summary: Most insect bites/stings improve in a few days. NHS: remove stinger by scraping (not tweezers), wash, ice pack wrapped, elevate, pharmacy antihistamine/hydrocortisone if suitable. Urgent advice if worsening, sting in mouth/throat/near eyes, tummy pain/vomiting, dizziness, fever with swollen glands, multiple stings, or prior severe allergy. Emergency for anaphylaxis features.
seeDoctorIf: Stung in mouth, throat, or near eyes
Dizziness, tummy pain/vomiting, fever with glands, multiple stings, prior severe reaction
selfCare: Scrape stinger sideways; wash with soap; cold pack up to 20 min; raise the area
doNot: Do not squeeze a bee stinger with tweezers
Do not invent adrenaline doses — use prescribed auto-injector if you have one

fr.summary: La plupart des piqûres s'améliorent en quelques jours. Retirer le dard en raclant, laver, glace. Urgence si anaphylaxie. Avis urgent si empire, bouche/gorge/yeux, malaise.
selfCare: Racler le dard ; laver ; froid ; surélever
doNot: Ne pas pincer le dard avec une pince

he.summary: רוב העקיצות משתפרות תוך ימים. להסיר עוקץ בגרידה, לשטוף, קרח. חירום באנפילקסיס. ייעוץ דחוף בהחמרה, פה/גרון/עיניים.
selfCare: לגרד עוקץ הצידה; לשטוף; קרח; להרים

ru.summary: Большинство укусов проходят за дни. Удалить жало соскабливанием, промыть, лёд. Неотложка при анафилаксии. Срочно при ухудшении, укусе во рту/горле/у глаз.
